name: Badge
description: Compact status label. Tone communicates semantic state; size adapts to dense or standard layouts.

tone.neutral: No semantic weight — a plain label or count.
tone.warning: Needs attention but is not blocking.

size.small: Dense contexts — tables, toolbars, compact rows.
size.medium: The default in forms and dialogs.

dos: Reference variables for every value; never hardcode a hex or px.
Change state through props, never by detaching the instance.
Keep text to a word or two.
Bind colour to a semantic tone token.
donts: Do not rely on colour alone to convey status — include text or an icon.
whenToUse: A short status, count, or category label.
whenNotToUse: Interactive primary actions — use a Button.

notes: Status is conveyed with text, not colour only (WCAG 1.4.1).
A removable chip's remove control needs an accessible name, e.g. "Remove <label>".
